name: domain
label: Company domain
help: For example `example.com`. A full URL also works; looot keeps the host. Give at least one of domain, name or linkedin_url. domain gives the best match.

name: name
label: Company name
help: Use it when you have no domain. Give at least one of domain, name or linkedin_url. domain gives the best match.

name: linkedin_url
label: LinkedIn company URL
help: For example `https://www.linkedin.com/company/example`. Give at least one of domain, name or linkedin_url. domain gives the best match.

name: fallback
label: Try other providers
help: When the first provider finds nothing, looot tries the next provider of the same job. Only the attempts that ran are charged.

name: maxCostUsd
label: Max cost (USD)
help: The most this module may spend across all providers it tries, for example `0.1`. Leave empty for the default cap. Used only when Try other providers is on.

name: wait
label: Wait (seconds)
help: How long to wait for the result, from 0 to 30. A run that takes longer comes back with the status `queued` or `running`; read it later with Get a run.

name: idempotencyKey
label: Idempotency key
help: The same key with the same input never pays twice. Leave empty and the module builds one from the input and the date.
